optional_mic_path.name: mic_permission_requested
optional_mic_path.explanation: User clicked 'Enable Mic Knock Detection'. Browser prompts for microphone access.

optional_mic_path.name: mic_listening
optional_mic_path.explanation: AnalyserNode samples mic audio every animation frame; baseline noise level tracks slowly via EMA.

optional_mic_path.name: audio_spike_detected
optional_mic_path.explanation: RMS amplitude crossed user threshold AND exceeded baseline × 4.0 AND cooldown elapsed.

optional_mic_path.name: knock_sequence_triggered
optional_mic_path.explanation: Mic detector fires `play_unlock` on the AnimationController. From here the rest of the visualization is identical to the manual unlock path — see the main `states` array below starting at `knock_detected`.

states.name: locked_idle
states.electrical_flow: Arduino idle, motor driver disabled, battery resting
states.explanation: Resting state. Arduino is awake and listening on the knock-sensor input.

states.name: knock_detected
states.explanation: Vibration on the door reaches the sensor. The Arduino reads the digital edge and starts pattern timing.

states.name: pattern_validated
states.electrical_flow: Internal — Arduino compares timing against stored secret pattern
states.explanation: Pattern matches. Arduino prepares to enable the motor driver.

states.name: power_activated
states.explanation: Arduino raises an enable signal; the motor driver gates battery current to the motor.

states.name: motor_rotates
states.mechanical_motion: Motor armature begins to spin around Y
states.explanation: Current through the motor coils generates torque on the rotor.

states.name: shaft_drives_gear
states.mechanical_motion: Vertical shaft rotates about Y; couples directly into gear hub
states.explanation: The motor's torque is delivered to the gear through the rigid coupler at the bottom of the shaft.

states.name: gear_rotates
visual_highlights: Curved yellow rotation arrow above gear
states.mechanical_motion: Gear spins about Y; teeth pass through rack engagement zone
states.explanation: Brass spur gear converts shaft rotation into tangential force at the pitch circle.

states.name: rack_moves
visual_highlights: Rack visibly slides along X (with bolt)
states.mechanical_motion: Rack slides linearly in -X (toward housing center)
states.explanation: Gear teeth engage the rack teeth, translating rotation into horizontal travel.

states.name: bolt_retracts
states.explanation: The bolt is rigidly attached to the rack and exits the strike plate cavity.

states.name: unlocked
states.electrical_flow: Motor driver disabled to save battery
states.explanation: Door is now free to open. System awaits relock command or auto-relock timer.

states.name: relock_requested
states.electrical_flow: Arduino re-enables motor driver in REVERSE polarity
states.explanation: Triggered by user button or timer.

states.name: motor_reverses
states.mechanical_motion: Motor and gear spin opposite direction
states.explanation: H-bridge swaps current direction to drive the motor backwards.

states.name: bolt_extends
visual_highlights: Bolt slides back into strike plate
states.explanation: The mechanical chain runs in reverse and the bolt reseats.
